title: Test handoff get CLI behavior
description: Add CLI unit tests for the default newest global read, --task, --all-scopes, positive --limit, and --all. Verify conflicts and nonpositive limits fail with usage guidance. Check human rendering, no-result output, the --all hint when matching records are truncated, the --all-scopes --all hint when task-scoped records are hidden by the global default, and JSON fields handoffs,totalMatching,hasMore,otherScopesAvailable.
